title: This Bat Fishes at Night, Raking Fish Out With Huge Feet

scenes.text: This bat fishes in the dark.
It's a greater bulldog bat, weighing about two to three ounces.
It uses echolocation to spot ripples from fish.
Then it flies just inches above the water.
Its huge hooked claws rake through and snag the fish.
It can store catches in its cheeks and keep fishing.

description:
The greater bulldog bat finds fish by echolocation, skims inches above the water, and rakes them out with big, hooked claws.
It can even stash partly chewed fish in its cheek pouches to keep fishing.
Have you ever seen a bat fish?
first_comment: Would you have guessed a bat could fish?
